📦 **sirius-workers901-blockside `f14ee66`** — feat(townfolk): keep workers near matching workplaces

Cache matching lots and nearest street positions; patrol a short street segment beside workplaces with deterministic time-based movement. Missing, hidden and distant workplaces preserve ordinary routes. Add per-sheet street lineup so every worker appears once despite population sampling, using each character's height and palettes. Twelve role tests, route bounds, deterministic replay and fallback controls pass; build --code preserves21 ships and passes source/ownership/shell gates.

Refs TASK-0901

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
